items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against Kindergeld decision
items.quote: Sie können gegen diese Festsetzung innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch bei der Familienkasse Musterfulda erheben. Die Frist beginnt mit der Bekanntgabe, die bei Versand durch die Post am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post eintritt.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19 Nov 2026 (posting day). By §122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO a letter posted by an authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Mon 23 Nov 2026 (not a weekend/holiday in HE, so no shift needed for the delivery day itself). Counting of the one-month Einspruch period starts the day after delivery (§187 Abs.1 BGB / §108 Abs.1 AO), i.e. from 23 Nov 2026, and ends one month later per §188 Abs.1 BGB on 23 Dec 2026. 23 Dec 2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Hessen (the Familienkasse's seat), so no further shift applies (§108 Abs.3 AO).

items.title: Submit new Studienbescheinigung for Clara by end of summer semester
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie uns zum Ende des Sommersemesters eine neue Studienbescheinigung ein.
items.computation: The letter does not give a specific calendar date, only 'zum Ende des Sommersemesters' (by the end of the summer semester). Clara started in Wintersemester 2026/27, so the next Sommersemester is 2027. German university summer semesters conventionally end on 30 September, so the earliest plausible reading is 30 Sep 2027, but the exact institutional end date (Beispielfulda) is not stated in the letter, so this is an estimate.

warnings: The 'end of summer semester' deadline for the new Studienbescheinigung is not a concrete calendar date in the letter; the due date given (30 Sep 2027) is an estimate based on typical German semester calendars, not a date stated by the Familienkasse or the Hochschule Beispielfulda — confirm the exact deadline with the university or Familienkasse.

The holiday calendar used for the Einspruch deadline shift is that of Hessen (the Familienkasse's seat in Musterfulda), as required by the deemed-delivery and §108 Abs.3 AO rules, even though the recipient lives in NRW; this did not change the result here.
